title: Homesite Class and the Builder Extended Rate Lock Loan Limit
content:
The site-plan class of the homesite behind the purchase affects the allowed loan-to-value percent of a Builder Extended Rate Lock's resized loan limit.

**Guideline.** Where the converted Homesite Reservation on the agreement is a Water-View Homesite or a Golf-Frontage Homesite, 2.0 points come off the allowed loan-to-value percent; where it is a Greenbelt Homesite or a Cul-de-Sac Homesite, 1.0 point comes off; any other class takes nothing off. The points are taken from the allowed loan-to-value percent before it is applied to the price basis.

| Class of the converted Homesite Reservation | Off the allowed loan-to-value percent |
|---|---|
| Water-View Homesite | 2.0 points |
| Golf-Frontage Homesite | 2.0 points |
| Greenbelt Homesite | 1.0 point |
| Cul-de-Sac Homesite | 1.0 point |
| any other class | nothing |

The class is the class of the Homesite Reservation that converted into the purchase agreement the lock finances; the purchase agreement record carries the link to that reservation.

Hypothetical: a 180-Day Extended Lock on a Golf-Frontage Homesite with no other change to the percent: 95 less 2.0 is 93 percent.
